meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 让它对比当前代码（HEAD）与 npm 上已发布的最新版本，按发布层（omo pure components、omo opencode、omo codex）列出还没发布的改动，用平实语言说明实际改了什么，并给出各层与整体的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你提到 “unpublished changes”、“changelog” 等关键词，或想知道哪些改动还没发布时，它会直接开始分析，不反问、不寒暄。

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和最新发布的 npm 版本，列出未发布的改动
say.note: 输出分层改动清单与版本建议

say.text: oh-my-opencode 这次该发 patch 还是 minor？
say.note: 按层给出 patch/minor/major 建议

say.text: 这些改动里哪些是 breaking change？
say.note: 按受影响层列出破坏性变更

howto.what_en: It compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions and lists all unpublished changes by release layer, describing the real diff instead of copying commit messages, then outputs a layered impact matrix and version bump suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog" or "what changed", or ask which changes are not yet published; it then outputs the analysis immediately without asking questions.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with published npm versions and list the unpublished changes
say_en.note: Gives a layer-by-layer change list and version bumps

say_en.text: Should oh-my-opencode ship a patch or a minor this time?
Which of these changes are breaking changes?
say_en.note: Lists breaking changes by affected layer
